title: Yogic Diet - Eating for Health and Peace
fullDetails: Food impacts not only physical health and weight, but also our moods,  emotions, and attitudes. Come find out which ingredients have what  impact on our bodies and minds. Learn how to prepare tasty, balanced  meals for the family using only plant-based yogic ingredients and to  design meals that make you "Sattvic" - Sanskrit for non-violent, pure,  and peaceful. We won't be cooking, but we will leave class empowered to  make more conscious food choices and to change our eating habits to keep  our minds in a peaceful state.
venue: All That Matters Center for Yoga & Holistic Education

title: Foundations of Zen
fullDetails: Zen is understanding ourselves and helping all beings. This introduction  to the practice of zen includes instruction and the practice of  sitting, walking, and chanting meditations. Learn about kong an  (koan) practice, the history of the Zen Buddhist tradition, and its  relevance to our lives in the modern world.  Leave with a foundation on  which to build your own practice as well as information about the  resources available to assist you. Jamie and Nancy are longtime teachers  and students of Zen.
venue: All That Matters Center for Yoga & Holistic Education

title: Qigong
fullDetails: Qigong is an ancient art of cultivating the body's vital energy - called  Qi (pronounced "Chee"). It has long been practiced in Asia to promote  health and healing. Traditional Eastern Medicine views Qi as the basic  constituent of our body as well as of the Universe. In this workshop  explore this ancient internal cultivation method through breath,  movements, and guided thoughts. Raise your awareness of Qi for health  promotion and bring yourself into balance and harmony with the world  around you. Learn techniques to activate the energy centers that  regulate our bodily functions, as well as specific breathing techniques  to strengthen the core and ignite your creative energy potential. You  will also learn microcosmic and macrocosmic Qi harmonizing, two of the  most universally practiced Daoist cultivation techniques. Includes an  introduction to the philosophical foundation to deepen your  understanding of the Qigong practice. This workshop is designed to meet  the needs of participants: come to one session or refine your practice  each month. Open to everyone.
venue: All That Matters Center for Yoga & Holistic Education

title: An Introduction to Gong Sound Healing
fullDetails: Sound has the power to transform lives, creating physical, mental,  emotional, and spiritual wellbeing. When physical illness or mental,  emotional or spiritual dis-ease present themselves, the vibration of the  body's energy field becomes dissonant. Sound healing entrains the  vibration back to a healthy strong resonant level. Join Stephanie  Marisca, gongmaster and sacred tone artist, for this experiential  workshop to discover how to use the bronze gong, singing bell bowls,  toning and chanting for healing; and acquaint yourself with the gong's  esoteric and mystical origins as well as present day applications. Learn  basic skills of the healing tone artist, and explore the applications  to sound healing, energetic balancing, and sacred intention for ceremony  and ritual. We will discuss what to consider when purchasing your own  gong or other sound healing tools. Leave with the knowledge to apply  these skills into your personal life for greater harmony and balance.   We will end our experience with a relaxing Gong Bath to tune your  vibration to a healthier, higher and more vibrant level. All are  welcome, no prior experience necessary.

This workshop retreat beginning March 18, 2011, is a wonderful way to welcome spring with improved timing skills in a spectacular setting. Matthew Montfort is the author of Ancient Traditions – Future Possibilities: Rhythmic Training Through the Traditions of Africa, Bali and India. The book, which is the basis for this world music workshop, received rave reviews in publications such as GUITAR PLAYER, ELECTRONIC MUSICIAN, DRUMS AND DRUMMING, and the SAN FRANCISCO CHRONICLE. Material from the book has been used by many teachers and musicians around the world, including Reinhard Flatischler, founder of the TaKeTiNa rhythm training process, and Steve Smith, famed jazz and rock drummer.

The workshop is presented in an easy to follow, entertaining yet educational format for all music lovers. African polyrhythms, Balinese kotèkan and Indian classical music were chosen as the source material for the training because these three traditions in combination cover the major types of rhythmic organization used in most of the world's music. Not just for musicians and percussionists, this training can help anyone with a desire to improve their rhythmic skills. Melodic aspects of the traditions will also be explored through vocal chanting and ensemble performance in a supportive setting. The workshop is open to all levels, and no musical background is required. Very simple to play percussion instruments will be provided, and participants are free to bring any percussive or melodic instruments they enjoy playing.

About Matthew Montfort

As leader of the world music group Ancient Future, Matthew Montfort has devoted himself to the scalloped fretboard guitar since 1978. He spent years of study with some of the world's best musicians, such as gamelan director K.R.T. Wasitodipuro, North Indian sarod master Ali Akbar Khan, and vina master K.S. Subramanian, with whom he did an intensive study of South Indian note-bending techniques. He was interviewed in the December 2009 Les Paul issue of Guitar Player Magazine about the scalloped fretboard guitar and the application of the rules of Indian raga to the music of Jimi Hendrix as exemplified by 'Purple Raga' from his debut solo recording, Seven Serenades for Scalloped Fretboard Guitar. He has performed concerts worldwide, from the Festival Internacional de la Guitarra on the golden coast of Spain to the Festival of India in Mumbai. He has worked with many world music legends, including tabla phenomenon Zakir Hussain and Chinese zither master Zhao Hui.

Learn how to fill a leadership role and master the challenges coming at you in an agile or a more traditional setting.

 

Learn how to plan out a business analysis effort, and how to see your plans integrated into the project plan (collaboration with project management).

 

Learn how to deal with troublesome personalities and threatening situations without fighting or retreating.

Learn how to maintain a centered position, and how to operate from this position of strength to influence others, resolve conflict, and keep things moving forward.


 

At the end of this seminar, students will know how to:

 

  • Educate stakeholders, including executives and team members, on the business analysis approach to be used.
  • Establish and document stakeholder roles and responsibilities in the upcoming business analysis effort
  • Use targeted communication tools to move people and projects forward.
  • Act as a liaison between all involved parties, a “language coach, not a translator”*

  • Deploy a “win-win” management style that keeps the focus on business objectives and accountability.
  • Practice the art of leadership from a position of mutual respect. It is a position that is free from guilt, fear, and the burden of other people’s personal issues.

fullDetails:

WHO:  Delray Beach International Tennis Championships (ITC) 

WHAT: Tennis on the Ave – featuring John McEnroe and Mats Wilander 

WHEN:  Friday, February 18 – 5:30 pm 

WHERE: Atlantic Avenue from NE 1st Avenue to NE 2nd Avenue . 

DETAILS: FREE admission to watch a Grand Slam grudge match between McEnroe and Wilander in the middle of Atlantic Avenue.  Fans will be enjoy a trip down tennis’ version of memory lane as these two Grand Slam champions and former No. 1 players in the world go stroke for stroke on Delray Beach’s fabled main street. The Avenue action is a prelude to the evening’s featured matches at the Delray Beach ITC. Tournament play starts at 7:00pm at the Delray Beach Stadium & Tennis Center . ANYONE BRINGING A RECEIPT SHOWING THEY PURCHASED SOMETHING IN DELRAY BEACH THAT DAY WILL RECEIVE 20 PERCENT OFF RESERVED SEATS THAT NIGHT, OR 10 PERCENT OFF BOX SEATS (up to four seats).  

“Tennis on the Ave” festivities will begin with the ITC VolleyGirls warming up the crowd, ticket and merchandise giveaways and KOOL 105.5 morning show personalities Mo and Sally playing hosts and your favorite songs. Come early, stay late, and investigate downtown's undiscovered art enclaves and burgeoning business opportunities...STAY & PLAY DELRAY! 

“Tennis on the Ave” is sponsored by Celsius fitness beverage, Delray Beach CRA, Business Delray, Destination Delray Beach, Kool 105.5 and Atlantic Ave Magazine. For more information and to purchase tickets to the Delray Beach ITC (February 18 – 27) call 561-330-6000 or visit www.yellowtennisball.com. 

About the Delray Beach International Tennis Championships: The Delray Beach International Tennis Championships (ITC) is the only ATP tournament in the world featuring an ATP Champions Tour event and an ATP World Tour event in the same week. Scheduled for February 18-27, 2011 at the Delray Beach Stadium & Tennis Center in Delray Beach, Florida, the ITC annually attracts the best tennis players in the world and thousands of visitors to Delray Beach and Palm Beach County. In October, the tournament received the 2010 Providencia Award from the Palm Beach County Convention & Visitor's Bureau for its extraordinary contribution to tourism, and it was also honored in 2003 with the ATP Award of Excellence. The privately-owned $500,000 ATP World Tour event is entering its 19th year (13th in Delray Beach) and features one of 11 ATP World Tour events in the United States and the first-ever ATP Champions Tour event played on US soil. Total player compensation is more than $1 million for both events. For more information, please visit www.YellowTennisBall.com. 

About Celsius "Tennis on the Ave" presented by Delray Beach Community Development Agency (CRA): "Tennis on the Ave" started last year as an impromptu tennis match on Delray's fabled Atlantic Avenue and turned into an overnight sensation with more than 2,000 people cramming the Avenue for a glimpse of legend John McEnroe and fellow ATP Champions Tour participant Ronald Agenor. Delray Beach Mayor Woodie McDuffie will be back in the umpire's chair for McEnroe's return to the "Ave" on Friday, Feb. 18 at 5:30 pm for a Grand Slam "grudge match" against legendary foe Mats Wilander. The free event is part of the STAY AND PLAY DELRAY initiative to showcase Delray Beach 's bustling cafes, boutiques and art galleries and to call attention to business opportunities within the city. 

About ATP: ATP is the governing body of the men's professional tennis circuits - the ATP World Tour, the ATP Champions Tour and the ATP Challenger Tour. 

About ATP World Tour: With 62 tournaments in 32 countries, the ATP World Tour showcases the finest male athletes competing in the world's most exciting venues. From Australia to Europe and the Americas to Asia, the stars of the ATP World Tour battle for South African Airways ATP Ranking Points at Grand Slams (non ATP members), ATP World Tour Masters 1000, ATP World Tour 500 and ATP World Tour 250  events. At the end of the season the world's top 8 ranked men's singles players and top 8 doubles teams, based on their performance throughout the year, qualify to compete in the season's climax - the Barclays ATP World Tour Finals at London's O2 arena. For more information, please visit www.atpworldtour.com. 

About ATP Champions Tour: The ATP Champions Tour brings together many of the greatest tennis players in history for nostalgic, competitive and entertaining tournaments in cities all around the world. There are currently 11 round robin events on 4 continents featuring former ATP World Tour players who fit one of the following criteria: formerly ranked No. 1 in the world in singles, a Grand Slam singles champion or finalist, or a singles player on a winning Davis Cup team. Players must also be retired from ATP World Tour competition and each event can invite two wild card entrants of its choice. Players receive points throughout the year which contributes to their standing in the South African Airways Rankings. The Circuit culminates at the Royal Albert Hall in London , England in December.

title: Compatible Blind Date
fullDetails:
What is the compatible blind date event?
It’s a quick and casual, about 45 min date over a cup of latte between two people who have the followings things in common but have not seen each other. It’s an opportunity to test the waters, get to know someone and see if there's any connection. We do all the work for you picking the place, time and matching you, all you need to do is show up.
Whether it ends up being a love story for your future children or the funniest story of all time, over 90% of our daters end up with a match. And if you have no match, no worries, your next date is free of charge.
The date and time is conveniently set up so you could meet up right after work.

To qualify for compatible blind date you have to:

1. Be within the recommended age bracket.
2. Be looking for a serious relationship.
3. Have a college degree.
4. Have a steady income source.
5. Be a non-smoker.
6. Be outgoing and active.
7. Be pleasant to an eye (definition of a good-looking obviously varies from person to person, but please look presentable).

How does it work?

Once you reserve your ticket, we would ask you to provide us with the best mobile contact info for your date to text or email so you could find each other at the venue.
Please arrive about 5 min before a scheduled start time.
Then you would locate your date.
Please keep your questions simple and casual. The date should take no longer than 45 min.
A common fear for people is ”What if I run out of the things to talk about?” No worries. We have some fun questions that will keep you busy during the entire date.

What happens after the event/how do I know if we matched?

After your date has ended, please login www.dateanddash.com and click on "my matches". If you are male, your dater’s number is 31, if you are female, your dater’s number is 1.
You will then enter your "yes" or “no” answer into our automated matching system. A mutual match is if you said "yes" to them and they said "yes" to you. To make sure you do not miss your love connection, we ask that everybody to enter their matches within 72 hours of the event. Ultimately, you can also exchange business cards with each other at the event.
Safety First/Good advice:

We provide a safe meeting and fun experience, and we never had any issues during datenaddash events in the past, although, please always use a common sense and be safe while meeting a person for the first time.
We ask that you:
2. Do not accept a pick up or a ride to or from your home.
2.Tell a friend where you're going and who you're meeting. Someone should always know where you are and how to get a hold of you. Have your friend call you while you're on the date to make sure you're okay.
3.Limit the amount of alcohol you drink on a first date. You need to have your cognitive abilities to make decisions. Keep your glass within your sights.
4.The objective here is to have fun and meet that special someone in a safe and fun environment.

Disclaimer: DateandDash has not performed any criminal background check on any participating individuals. Please use a common sense and date under your own risk, no lifeguard on duty. We are normally get an even amount of men and women, however we do not guarantee an even gender ratio at the event. ?We do guarantee that if you do not get matched, your next event is free. Drinks/Food not included into the ticket price. It can be ordered off the menu. Each person gets a separate check, and pays only for what they ordered (please remind your server to bring you separate checks). Ticket includes arranging the company, and matching services after the event. DateandDash is not affiliated with venues where events are being held.
